keyVerseDR: "...falling down they adored him: and opening their treasures, they offered him gifts..." (Mt 2:11)

level1.title: Wise Men Follow the Star
level1.story: Wise men came from far away, following a star. They found Baby Jesus with Mary. They knelt and gave Him their gifts.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What gifts did the Wise Men bring?
What gift can you give Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I give You my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Follow the star
activity.intro: Connect the dots to make the star of Bethlehem.

level2.title: The Magi Find the King
level2.story: Wise men came from the East to Jerusalem, saying, "We have seen His star in the east, and are come to adore Him." King Herod was troubled and asked where the Christ would be born. The priests said in Bethlehem of Judah, as the prophet had written. The star went before the wise men and stood over where the child was. They found the child with Mary His mother, adored Him, and opened their treasures: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
level2.keyLine: Falling down they adored him: and they offered him gifts.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does each gift say about Jesus?
How do you 'follow the star' today?
level2.prayer: Jesus, King of all, I offer You my life. Amen.

activity.title: We have seen His star
activity.text: We have seen His [star] in the east, and are come to [adore] Him.
